change_scope: Combine real manually armed Arcturus depth acquisition with the existing room-only dashboard close behavior. Add successful native exposure observation, exact metadata/pair identity, calibrated rolling-row rectification, historical standing poses and a privilege-dropped local reader. The installer owns both ARM executables and offers explicit per-session Enable/Stop actions without camera boot integration.

headset_close_validation.scope: Previously accepted room-only close implementation is unchanged. The combined candidate adds capture-epoch rejection and source cleanup; software tests cover these changes. The new complete binary awaits wearer validation.

limits: The complete installed candidate still needs wearer checks for projection/controller alignment and scan accuracy.
Capture requires visible colour passthrough, settled exposure, very slow movement with pauses and independent translated viewpoints.
Uncertain distant surfaces remain marked as requiring more views; unseen space has no invented geometry or completion percentage.
Manual element authoring is available; automatic recognition, Quest Scene API and game/Venture room adapters remain pending.
Experimental camera access is never enabled by boot/login/dashboard startup. Enable is a separate explicit installer session action.
renderer_tests: Actual offscreen Vulkan upload/readback for 150 changing frames with stable image allocations and exact RGBA.

source_headset_validation.scope: Production native source header exercised in a temporary diagnostic consumer. This establishes real observations and their software reconstruction, not visual alignment of the complete installed dashboard or full-room accuracy.

validation_basis: Exact unchanged transport artifacts retain the previous checked source closure. Current source/artifact pins bind the new dashboard, helper and installer. Native kernel/API/geometry/timing/pose checks, room lifecycle, installer transactions, PC-only behavior, real Textual UI and real PowerShell extraction pass. Scoped headset source/session/close observations are separate from whole-package validation.
